veranderings.blok: Kopers ver van die woud af
veranderings.voor: elders in die land waar die bos gestaan het en in ander lande
veranderings.na: elders in dieselfde land as die woud en in ander lande
veranderings.rede: 'in die land waar die bos gestaan het' can be read as the very piece of ground (land) where the forest stood, rather than the same country; naming the country removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
'armer as wat dit vroeër was' is the natural Afrikaans comparison; 'die grond van vroeër' is wooden and repeats 'grond'; the protected wording before it is untouched.
